hashConvention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 LF file text and exact Pester It AST extent. ForEach cases are reviewed as a group.

selectors.selector: refuses a planted file without changing the version or registering a task
selectors.reviewScope: Conflicting SYSTEM directory is preserved and no task is registered. Task and ACL cmdlets are mocked.

selectors.selector: refuses a SYSTEM staging parent that allows other accounts to create children
selectors.reviewScope: Rejects the parent before populating it, without a task registration. ACL outcomes are mocked.

selectors.selector: protects the complete SYSTEM stage outside link-health before registering its task
selectors.reviewScope: Verifies the stage path, protection before exposure and manifest before registration. ACL and scheduler effects are mocked.

selectors.selector: reuses a matching installed payload without opening its files for writing
selectors.reviewScope: Holds the original file open for reads only and checks manifest reuse. Scheduler calls are mocked.

selectors.selector: plans the same Linux version for LF and CRLF source bytes
selectors.reviewScope: Exercises installer planning with both line endings and no target creation.

selectors.selector: publishes the captured Linux bytes once and preserves a damaged version
selectors.reviewScope: Executes the normalized staged bytes on Linux. Covers preservation after damage, with no live service activation.

selectors.selector: leaves an allow-listed task alone when its action is <Name>
selectors.reviewScope: Requires Windows for scheduled-task mocking. All three existing refusals remain enabled on Windows.

selectors.selector: registers the user task least-privileged with logon, USB4, network, resume and periodic triggers
selectors.reviewScope: Synthetic XML preserves the event, principal and non-mutating action assertions on both platforms.

selectors.selector: can build the interactive-token fallback for hosts without the batch logon right
selectors.reviewScope: Synthetic XML preserves the caller logon type on both platforms.

selectors.selector: gives only the owner's SYSTEM task a boot trigger and Apply mode
selectors.reviewScope: Synthetic XML preserves SYSTEM principal, boot delay and Apply on both platforms.

selectors.selector: keys the install directory on file content
selectors.reviewScope: Changing source file bytes selects another payload version.

selectors.selector: refuses reuse when the matching SYSTEM <TargetKind> is untrusted
selectors.reviewScope: Both cases preserve a real hash-matching payload and refuse registration when the mocked SYSTEM trust guard denies its directory or the script.
